description: Calculate a GPA from a list of courses with credits and grades, optionally weighted with a credit multiplier on each course, and optionally combined with an earlier GPA and credit total. The GPA for the courses you pass is the term GPA, and adding earlier work with prior_gpa and prior_credits gives the cumulative GPA. Inputs: courses (each with credits greater than 0, a grade that is a letter like "B+" or a percentage like 87, and an optional credit_multiplier greater than 0 such as 1.1 for an AP class), a scale id, and optional prior_gpa and prior_credits to fold in earlier terms. A credit_multiplier above 1 gives a course more weight in the weighted GPA, and when any course has one other than 1 the tool also returns weighted_gpa and weighted_credits. The term GPA still uses the plain credits. Pass drop_lowest to leave the lowest graded courses out of the GPA, as schools do that drop the lowest course; the dropped courses are named in dropped_courses. Pass prior_gpa and prior_credits together, or leave both out. Passing only one of the two is an error, so the tool says which one is missing. Alternatively, pass transcript_csv as a CSV string with columns for course name, credits, grade and optional credit multiplier; a header row is optional, the columns can be in any order, and header names like Course Title, Final Grade and Credit Hours are read as the name, grade and credits columns. When courses is not given, transcript_csv is parsed and used as the course list. In transcript_csv, a P is read as pass, NP as not pass and W as withdrawn. Those rows are left out of the GPA and named in the answer, except where the scale gives the letter points, such as P on australia-hd. Example prompt: "What's my GPA if I got an A in 3 credits, a B+ in 4 credits and a C in 3 credits?"

courses.description: The courses to include. Each needs credits (greater than 0) and a grade (a letter like "B+" or a percentage like 87). name is optional, and so is credit_multiplier (greater than 0), which gives a course more weight in the weighted GPA. Required when transcript_csv is not given.

credit_multiplier.description: Optional multiplier on the credits for a weighted GPA, greater than 0, like 1.1 for an AP class. Defaults to 1.

grade.description: A letter like "B+" or a percentage like 87 or "87%".

drop_lowest.description: Number of courses with the lowest grade points to leave out of the GPA, 0 or more, for schools that drop the lowest course. It must be less than the number of graded courses. Ties go to the course listed first. Defaults to 0.

prior_credits.description: Credits from earlier terms, 0 or more. Pass this together with prior_gpa to get a cumulative GPA. Passing only one of the two is an error.

prior_gpa.description: GPA from earlier terms, 0 to 7. Pass this together with prior_credits to get a cumulative GPA. Passing only one of the two is an error.

scale.description: Grade scale id: "us4", "us4plus", "ontario-college", "uk-classification", "australia-hd" or "weighted-5.0". Defaults to "us4". Ask the student which one their school uses if unsure.

transcript_csv.description: A CSV string with columns for course name, credits, grade and optional credit multiplier. A header row is optional, the columns can be in any order, and header names like Course Title, Final Grade and Credit Hours are read as the name, grade and credits columns. P, NP and W grades are left out of the GPA. When courses is not given, this is parsed and used as the course list. Example: "Course,Credits,Grade\nCalculus,4,A\nHistory,3,B+"

name: calculate_gpa

courses.description: One entry per graded course, in the order they were passed.

credit_multiplier.description: The credit multiplier of the course, when one other than 1 was passed.

letter.description: The letter the course counts as on the scale.

points.description: Grade points the letter is worth on the scale.

quality_points.description: Grade points times credits, what the course adds to the total.

weighted_credits.description: Credits times the credit multiplier, when a multiplier other than 1 was passed.

weighted_quality_points.description: Grade points times the weighted credits, when a multiplier other than 1 was passed.

credits.description: The credits of the graded courses in this call.

cumulative_credits.description: The credits of these courses and the earlier terms together, when prior_gpa and prior_credits were both passed.

cumulative_gpa.description: The GPA with the earlier terms folded in, when prior_gpa and prior_credits were both passed.

dropped_courses.description: Courses left out because of drop_lowest. Empty when drop_lowest is 0 or not passed.

grade.description: The letter the dropped course counted as on the scale.

excluded_courses.description: Courses left out of the GPA because they are not graded, such as P, NP and W rows in transcript_csv. Empty when none were left out.

credits.description: Credits of the course left out.

grade.description: The grade that kept the course out of the GPA, such as P, NP or W.

name.description: Name of the course left out of the GPA.

gpa_credits.description: The credits that count in the GPA, the same graded credits the term GPA is divided by. Excluded courses add nothing here.

scale.description: The scale id the courses were marked on.

scale_name.description: The name of the scale the courses were marked on.

term_gpa.description: The GPA for these courses alone.

weighted_credits.description: The credits after the credit multipliers are applied, when at least one multiplier other than 1 was passed.

weighted_gpa.description: The GPA with each course's credits multiplied by its credit_multiplier, when at least one multiplier other than 1 was passed. It covers the courses in this call, not the earlier terms.

title: Calculate GPA
